# elitk-8

> Enterprise AI marketing & social automation suite — React 18 + Express 5 + Drizzle ORM + TypeScript

## Project

- Author: Mohamed Osama — mohamedosamaai
- Homepage: https://8.elitk.com
- Repository: https://github.com/mohamedosamaai/elitk-8
- License: MIT

## Architecture

- Pattern: Full-stack TypeScript monorepo (single-repo, co-located frontend + backend)
- Frontend: React 19 + Vite 8 + Tailwind CSS 4
- Backend: Express 4 + Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL
- AI Runtime: Google Gemini API (`@google/genai`)
- 3D / Media: Three.js + React Three Fiber + MediaPipe Face Mesh
- CI/CD: GitHub Actions (CI + CodeQL security scanning)
- Containerisation: Docker + Docker Compose

## Key Engineering Concepts Demonstrated

- Type-safe API contracts with Zod validation schemas
- Gemini AI agent orchestration with tool-calling pipelines
- Real-time audio synthesis with Web Audio API
- GPU-accelerated 3D particle rendering via WebGL / Three.js
- MediaPipe face-tracking integrated into browser canvas pipeline
- Express 4 middleware stack: CORS, rate-limiting, structured Pino logging
- Environment-driven configuration with strict schema validation
- Multi-stage Docker build for minimal production image size
- Automated dependency updates via Dependabot with peer-dependency guardrails

## Files

- `README.md`: Project overview, badges, quickstart guide
- `server.ts`: Express API entry point with middleware and route registration
- `src/`: React 19 frontend application (components, hooks, pages)
- `src/lib/`: Shared utility modules and API client layer
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: Node 22 CI pipeline — type-check → lint → test → build
- `.github/workflows/codeql.yml`: Automated CodeQL security scanning (weekly + on push)
- `docker-compose.yml`: Production compose stack (app + PostgreSQL)
- `docker-compose.dev.yml`: Local development stack with hot-reload
- `Dockerfile`: Multi-stage build — builder stage → production image
- `.env.example`: All required environment variables with placeholder values
- `scripts/`: Utility scripts for showcase extraction and repo automation
